description: List roles from the role taxonomy (title, slug, parent_slug). Returns the most common roles by default, the roles whose title matches q, or the roles directly under parent. At most 100 roles are returned; total is how many matched. The slugs are the values the role filter of search_jobs, job_trends, and salary_benchmarks accepts.

parent.description: Role slug; returns the roles directly under it (e.g. engineering)

q.description: Words to match against role titles (e.g. product designer)

name: list_roles
title: List roles
